subjective.citation_text: Doctor: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today? Patient: I'm 59 years old, and I'm male. I'm here for hypogonadism, and I've been on testosterone replacement therapy. I also wanted to talk about some concerns I have with gynecomastia. Doctor: Could you please describe the duration of your gynecomastia, any associated symptoms such as breast tenderness or pain, and whether you have noticed any changes in the size or appearance of the breast tissue? Patient: I haven't noticed any pain or tenderness, but I have seen some changes in the size of the breast tissue. It's been a while since I started the testosterone therapy, and I'm just now really paying attention to it. I wanted to bring it up because I've heard it can be related to hormone levels. Doctor: Could you please specify the duration of your testosterone replacement therapy and whether there have been any adjustments to the dosage or formulation over time? Patient: I've been on testosterone replacement therapy for a while now, and I've been taking 1 milliliter every 10 days. I haven't had any changes to the dosage or formulation, just sticking with what we've been using. Doctor: Could you describe the physical examination findings related to the breast tissue, including size, consistency, and any other abnormalities? Patient: I haven't had a physical exam for the breast tissue yet, but I wanted to bring it up because I've noticed some changes in size. I'm concerned it might be related to my hormone levels or the testosterone therapy. I was hoping we could discuss it further. Doctor: Could you please describe the timeline of when you first noticed the changes in breast tissue size and appearance, and whether there have been any other symptoms such as nipple discharge, skin changes, or weight gain? Patient: I first noticed the changes in my breast tissue size a few months back, maybe around the same time I started noticing improvements in my energy and sleep. I haven't had any nipple
